user.title: Ubuntu server details
user.description: Give this server a name and enter its SSH connection details. A unique Ed25519 key pair will be generated.

install.title: Install Ubuntu monitoring
install.description:
**[Open installation command with Copy button]({copy_url})**

A separate page opens with a one-click **Copy command** button. Paste and run it on your Ubuntu server, then return here and select **Submit** to verify SSH.

You can also select and copy the command from the field below. The SSH server key will be remembered on first connection.

data_description.install_command: Read-only. Select the entire command and copy it to your clipboard.

error.invalid_input: Enter a valid server name, host and monitoring account
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect via SSH. Run the installation command and check host, port, SSH and firewall settings.

abort.already_configured: This Ubuntu host is already configured
